rationale: The assistant clearly refused DIY re-gassing, said not to pierce pipes, and steered toward an engineer quote while weighing replacement on an old unit. It used the customer's evidence (no frost, barely warm back) to favour a sealed-system or compressor fault over a defrost fault. Weaknesses: the second reply repeated the condenser-cleaning and settings steps from the first. It also never asked about the refrigerant type or any past knife defrosting, and it did not mention the R600a flammability risk specifically or the ventilation advice for a fresh leak. Neither reply asked a targeted question, so the diagnostic probing was thin.
